headline: A banked reset is being distributed
sourceTimezone: PST (as written; EOD is not an exact time)
originalTimeText: Will be there by EOD PST.
scope: All paid accounts, as stated by Tibo.

announcement.text: Loading a banked reset in everyone's paid accounts.
announcement.translation: 正在向所有付费账号发放一次储备重置。

timingSource.text: Will be there by EOD PST.
timingSource.translation: 将在 PST 当天结束前到账。

note: Announced on Day 3 to celebrate 40M active users across Codex and ChatGPT Work. The reply refers to October 7 in Pacific time. EOD is not an exact hour; PST may be literal UTC-8 or a loose reference to local PDT (UTC-7). No precise arrival time or completed delivery has been verified. Post timestamps are recorded to the minute. The archive uses the announcement time, not arrival time.
